title: Security Council Lead Self-Nomination: alisha.eth
headline: The current Optimism Security Council Lead nominates themselves to continue in the Lead role.
summary: The nominee describes themselves as an individual based in New Zealand who has served as Optimism Security Council Lead since the council was created in November 2023, re-elected in 2024 and 2025. They cite helping set up the ZKsync Security Council in 2024 and earlier work launching governance at ENS, and say they are a qualified lawyer. They state they are not a software developer and that their technical skill is operational: Safe multisigs, hardware-wallet signing, transaction simulation, state-diff review and coordinating signing ceremonies. Their stated plan is an open, public nomination process plus targeted outreach, with candidates judged on the published Member Selection Criteria and the council composition requirements treated as hard constraints, and Foundation screening required before any nomination. They expect about 10-15 active hours per month, plus extra time during recruitment and emergencies, and say they are reachable 24/7 in emergencies. They state they have acted impartially and will disclose any conflict, noting working relationships with people and entities across the Ethereum ecosystem who could be key holders. This is a self-nomination post; no vote is scheduled in the post.
risk_flags: nominee states conflicts of interest will be disclosed
